result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical broken elements. There is a minor layout issue where the last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off, and a minor content issue with a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container has appropriate padding or snap behavior so users can clearly see that more content is available to scroll, or show a partial card to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a clear indication (like an ellipsis styling) that the text continues.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('...') or allow the full name to wrap or be visible on scroll.
